verdict.rationale: The portal publishes one service-availability window in advance: the online income-declaration correction service is open from 29 July to 30 November 2026. That is a date-range window for one service, not daily operating hours, and nothing covers per-day limits or session timeouts for the professional flows a founder would use. Missing for 10: daily operating-hours or maintenance windows, per-day submission limits, session timeout disclosure, coverage of the professional-space filing flows, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start

citations.quote: Le service de correction des déclarations de revenus en ligne est ouvert du 29 juillet au 30 novembre 2026 inclus.
